title: Correct the goal wording on #18336 / #11979: the requirement is 「no NULL-organization grant row」, NOT 「config is the only channel」 — the literal reading deletes the zero-config `single` promotion ADR-0131 keeps
body:
Two cards (#18336, #11979) state their goal as 「**config-derived standing is the only channel**」. Measured against ADR-0131 and against the running code, that phrasing asks for something **wider than the governing record requires**, and the extra width is exactly what breaks a zero-config deployment.

Filed at the maintainer's direction (2026-09-16T09:51Z), after the point was raised by them directly: 「比如临时启动的开发环境，我不可能去配置啊」.

## The conflation

Two separable things are being treated as one:

1. **Where platform-admin standing is ANCHORED** — a grant row whose `organization` is NULL, versus deployment config.
2. **How a ZERO-CONFIG deployment gets an administrator at all** — the `single`-posture first-user promotion.

ADR-0131 is about (1) only — its title is 「total organization ownership, no NULL organization_id」. ⛔ It nowhere requires config to be the only channel. Verbatim, `docs/adr/0131-*.md` **:360–363**:

> `single`-posture first-user promotion (Choice 4A), which today writes an `admin_full_access` grant row with a NULL organization, writes it **owned by the Default Organization** instead; under a walled [posture] … anchor retire with D13. **No NULL grant row is ever produced.**

⇒ ADR-0131 **keeps** the zero-config first-user promotion. It changes the row's OWNERSHIP, not its existence.

## Why the wording is load-bearing rather than cosmetic

Read literally, 「the only channel」 deletes (2) along with (1). Measured cost, from the #18336 dispatch:

- a default `single` deployment with nothing declared loses platform admin **entirely** — 11 pins go red, signature `expected 'MEMBER' to be 'PLATFORM_ADMIN'`, one of them named 「an unscoped admin_full_access grant still confers PLATFORM_ADMIN with **no config at all**」;
- `bootstrapPlatformAdmin` would keep minting a row that confers nothing — a **declared-not-enforced** defect written on purpose.

⚠️ And the operational case the maintainer named is the common one, ⛔ not an edge: a throw-away dev rig, a preview deploy, a test box. Nobody sets `OS_PLATFORM_OWNER_EMAIL` for those, and under the default posture nobody should have to.

## Proposed correction — ⛔ wording only, no scope change

| | |
|---|---|
| ❌ today | 「config-derived standing is the only channel」 |
| ✅ proposed | 「**no grant row with a NULL `organization` remains**」 |

Both halves of the migration then hold at once, which is what ADR-0131 actually describes: walled postures derive standing from config; `single` keeps promoting its first user with zero config, writing a Default-Organization-owned row.

⇒ Apply to **#18336**'s body and **#11979**'s body. ⚠️ #11979 is `domain:engine`, so its half is a cross-lane ask, ⛔ not this filing's to perform.

⛔ **This card does not decide #18336's A/B/C fork** (which governing record wins, and therefore whether the work is 17.x or v18). It is upstream of that: whichever line the work lands on, it should be described this way. If the ruling is A, this correction rides the re-scoping pass.

Dedup words: `config is the only channel wording` · `platform admin anchor vs bootstrap convenience` · `ADR-0131 Default Organization owned grant row` · `zero-config single posture promotion` · `NULL organization grant row retire`
